origin: Independently generated night-stadium artwork for OpenBMH. No original game assets.
method: Built-in image_gen edit; exported as uncompressed 24-bit TGA without changing pixels.
distribution: Project-supplied launcher artwork, distributed with OpenBMH under GPL-3.0-only.

changes: Replaced the city skyline above the stadium rim with dusk sky.
Added two netted goals and corrected the pitch markings, including a single center circle.

prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean stadium background artwork for the existing OpenBMH launcher, landscape approximately 16:10.
Edit target: the provided image. Make only these two localized corrections; preserve the stadium bowl, seating tiers, roof and floodlights, camera framing, foreground railing, blue/navy palette, warm dusk glow, dreamlike cinematic style, overall exposure and dark middle area for the existing UI overlay.

1. Remove the entire distant CITY SKYLINE above the far stadium rim: every building, tower, rooftop, tree silhouette and urban horizon. Seamlessly replace that band with the same dusk sky and clouds. Above the stadium's own roof/rim there must be SKY ONLY. Keep the stadium's structural roof supports and floodlights.

2. Correct the FOOTBALL PITCH in the lower part of the image, preserving its overall placement and green lighting. It is a real association-football pitch seen from a slightly elevated MIDFIELD SIDELINE seat: the two short goal-line ends are LEFT and RIGHT, not near/far center. Draw one coherent rectangular pitch in consistent perspective with realistic football geometry (105 by 68 metres). Exactly ONE halfway line across the width at midfield, exactly ONE center circle centered on that line, appearing elliptical because of the low viewpoint. At EACH of the left and right short ends, add ONE clearly recognizable white football goal, with TWO uprights, ONE crossbar and netting receding behind the goal line. Goal width-to-height about 3:1 (7.32m x 2.44m); realistic size in relation to the pitch. Add correctly placed penalty areas, smaller six-yard goal areas, penalty spots and penalty arcs on BOTH ends, four corner arcs and subtle corner flags. Do not put penalty boxes across midfield. Do not add duplicate circles, fake stripes, random white line fragments, a center-front goal, or a running track. Adjust only the grass/lines/goal areas as needed to fit a sensible single pitch. Both goals and correct layout should be visible within the existing image framing, even if a future UI overlay may cover part of them.

No UI panels, lettering, logos, advertisements with text, watermarks, players or extra architecture. Keep the original stylized mood; accuracy of the football equipment and markings matters more than adding detail.

Grass cleanup:
Edit the attached stadium illustration. This is an intermediate cleanup of the grass only, before correct markings are added separately.
COMPLETELY REMOVE EVERY WHITE PAINTED LINE AND SPOT ON THE GRASS. The entire playing field in the bottom part of the image must be continuous UNMARKED GREEN GRASS. NO center circle, NO halfway line, NO penalty boxes, NO goal-area lines, NO arcs, NO white grass markings whatsoever. Repaint the whole grass surface, not just a thin stroke. White goal frames with nets at the left and right edges must remain, since these are objects, not paint on grass. Keep corner flags. Everything above the pitch and the foreground rail must be unchanged: sky without any city silhouette, stadium, stands, lights, same composition and night colors.
The immediate output must show two goals beside an EMPTY UNMARKED RECTANGLE OF GREEN TURF. No text, no UI.

Final markings:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit only the unmarked GRASS in the supplied stadium image. Add a single realistic association-football pitch's thin white painted markings, in the existing perspective of a midfield sideline view, with the two goals at the LEFT and RIGHT ends.
Draw one complete perspective rectangle for the touchlines and goal lines, the goal lines aligned with the two existing goal mouths. At its middle draw exactly ONE straight halfway line from far touchline to near touchline and exactly ONE complete elliptical center circle centered on it, with one small center spot. Draw a rectangular penalty area and a smaller six-yard goal area at EACH goal end, with a penalty spot and a penalty arc outside each penalty area facing midfield. Draw tiny quarter-circle corner arcs at the four corners. The lines must follow one coherent standard full-size football pitch layout and perspective; no extra arcs or duplicate midfield circles.
The middle of the field is between the two left/right goals; do not draw a second circle near the far sideline. The width-to-depth of the visible center ellipse should be about 5:1 due to foreshortening. All marks are thin, subtle white paint, grounded on the existing grass.
Preserve the two existing netted goals, four corner flags, rail, sky with NO city, stands, floodlights, dark navy twilight style, composition, and every part above the grass exactly as they are. Do not add people, text, branding, UI or watermarks.

serialization.reason: Compatible row stride in the pinned Direct3D 11 loader; decoded RGB pixels are unchanged.
